descriptions.notStarted: You have now reached the apex of the Maple world, the one who is considered the ultimate warrior. To commemorate your sterling accomplishment of reaching level 200, #b#p2081100##k has something for you...
descriptions.inProgress: It's the one thing that countless warriors, who have taken their mind and body to the very limit, strived for, but couldn't get... but now, #p2081100# is introducing me to #t1902002#... I heard only the very best in the world of Maple can be friends with #t1902002#.
descriptions.completed: At a point where I never thought I could go any higher, I made a new friend that certainly put me over the top.
